final_wiki.answer-Q-5178:
2022-03-17 was a Thursday.

Calculation: January 1, 2022 was a Saturday. From Jan 1 to Mar 17: 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 16 (days before Mar 17) = 75 days. 75 mod 7 = 5. Saturday + 5 days = Thursday.
